title: Hearty Sweet Russian Milk Pudding
description: A resinous and glassy-jelly Russian dessert featuring sweetened condensed milk, perfect for a hangover cure, made in a raclette grill. This dish is onion and garlic free.
instructions: In a small bowl, sprinkle the gelatin over 1/4 cup of water and let it soften for 5 minutes.
In a medium saucepan, combine the sweetened condensed milk, heavy cream, and sugar, and heat over medium heat, stirring constantly.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 5 minutes, or until the sugar has dissolved.
Remove the saucepan from the heat and stir in the softened gelatin and vanilla extract.
Let the mixture cool to room temperature, then cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours, or until chilled.
Just before serving, whip the chilled coconut cream until stiff peaks form.
To assemble the pudding, spoon a layer of the chilled milk mixture into the raclette grill, followed by a layer of whipped coconut cream.
Repeat the layers one more time, ending with a layer of whipped coconut cream on top.
Sprinkle with shredded coconut, if using, and serve immediately.
